name: Negative Words
overview: Scripture reveals the profound impact of words, emphasizing that the tongue holds the power of life and death, and what proceeds from the mouth can defile a person (Proverbs 18:21; Matthew 15:11). Negative speech, such as cursing one's parents, is met with severe consequences, underscoring the seriousness of harmful words (Exodus 21:17). Believers are called to renew their minds and resist worldly patterns, aligning their speech with God's good and perfect will (Romans 12:2), trusting in His plans for peace rather than evil (Jeremiah 29:11).
